title: Revival in Mongolia: Partnering with God to Reach a Nation
description: In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner shares an incredible update on the ministry's work in Mongolia, where thousands are coming to Christ and God is moving in miraculous ways. You'll be inspired by the stories of revival and redemption, and challenged to join in the prayer and financial support that's making this movement possible. Join Pastor Chris as he shares the latest news from the front lines of the harvest, and discover how you can be a part of God's plan to touch millions.
